domains.use: The module reads the first-party cookie __mtm_pref, where the preference UI records the marketing usage the user chose (standard, personalized or non-marketing), and forwards that value to the cloud as id.usage. A cookie holding anything else is treated as no answer and no value is sent. The module never writes the cookie; the consent tool that asked the question does, with a 400 day lifetime. The 51Degrees script caches its cloud response in sessionStorage under fod; the module removes that entry when the consent it was fetched under has changed, so the reloaded response answers to the current consent.
